mapper.select: SELECT appt.ApptID AS appointmentId, mr.MedicalTime AS serviceDate, mr.MedicalTime AS serviceTime, appt.ApptStatus AS status, 'Medical' AS serviceType, 'Medical Service' AS serviceName, mr.MedicalFee AS price FROM appointment appt LEFT JOIN apptMedical am ON appt.ApptID = am.ApptID LEFT JOIN medicalRecord mr ON am.MedicalID = mr.MedicalID WHERE appt.PetID = #{petId} ORDER BY serviceDate DESC, serviceTime DESC

SELECT PetID as petId, UserID as userId, PetName as petName, Breed as breed, Gender as gender, BirthDate as birthDate, VaccineStatus as vaccineStatus, Remarks as remarks, AllergyDrug as allergyDrug, MedicalHistory as medicalHistory FROM pet WHERE UserID = #{userId} ORDER BY PetID
